EnC Power Bank 10000mAh 25W Fast Charging – Compact, Powerful & Reliable

The EnC Power Bank 10000mAh 25W fast charging solution is designed for users who need speed, safety, and portability in one smart device. Whether you are traveling, commuting, or working remotely, this power bank delivers consistent and efficient charging for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other USB-powered devices. With advanced fast-charging technology and a premium Li-polymer battery, it ensures long-lasting performance and dependable power on the go.

Built with a high-capacity 10000mAh 3.7V (37Wh) battery, this power bank provides ample backup power to keep your devices running throughout the day. The compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in your pocket, backpack, or laptop bag, making it an ideal travel power bank for daily use. The intelligent power management system protects your devices from overcharging, overheating, and short circuits.

Fast & Efficient 25W Charging Performance

The EnC Power Bank 10000mAh 25W fast charging capability allows you to charge compatible devices significantly faster than standard power banks. It supports multiple fast-charging protocols through USB-A, Type-C output, and built-in cables, ensuring wide compatibility with Android smartphones, iPhones, tablets, Bluetooth accessories, and more.

With a powerful Type-C Output up to 25W MAX, you can quickly recharge modern smartphones and even some compact tablets. The USB-A output supports multiple voltage levels, making this power bank suitable for both fast-charging and standard devices. This versatility makes it a reliable fast charging power bank for everyday and professional use.

Multiple Input & Output Options

This power bank is engineered to support modern charging needs with multiple input and output ports. The Type-C input allows faster recharging of the power bank itself, saving you valuable time. Integrated cables reduce the need to carry extra accessories, making it a convenient all-in-one charging solution.

  • Capacity: 10000mAh 3.7V (37Wh)
  • Battery Type: Li-polymer battery
  • Type-C Input: DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A
  • USB-A Output: DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A
  • Type-C Output: DC 5V/3A, 9V/2.7A, 12V/2.08A (25W MAX)
  • Type-C Cable Output: DC 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A
  • Lightning Output: DC 5V/3A (Max)

Safe, Durable & Travel-Friendly Design

Safety is a top priority in the EnC Power Bank 10000mAh 25W fast charging model. The high-quality Li-polymer battery offers better thermal stability and longer life compared to traditional batteries. Advanced safety features provide protection against over-voltage, over-current, short-circuit, and overheating, ensuring your devices remain safe during charging.

The sleek and durable outer shell is built to withstand daily wear and tear, making it suitable for frequent travelers and professionals. Its airline-safe capacity complies with international flight regulations, allowing you to carry it confidently in your hand luggage.

Wide Compatibility for Everyday Devices

This fast charging power bank is compatible with a wide range of devices, including Android smartphones, iPhones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, Bluetooth speakers, and other USB-powered gadgets. Thanks to its smart output detection, it automatically delivers the optimal charging speed for each connected device.

Whether you need a reliable mobile charging solution for work, travel, or emergencies, the option delivers the perfect balance of performance, portability, and safety. If you are looking for a compact power bank with fast charging, multiple outputs, and premium battery technology, this model is an excellent choice. The combination of 25W fast charging, built-in cables, and universal compatibility makes it a smart investment for modern users who demand efficiency and reliability from their charging accessories. Upgrade your charging experience today with the device and stay powered anytime, anywhere.
